title: Cobblemon Lounge Pack
description: Modpack para o servidor Cobblemon Lounge. (Modpack for the Cobblemon Lounge server.)
body:
# Cobblemon Lounge Pack

Cobblemon Lounge Pack é o modpack para o servidor 'Cobblemon Lounge' com Cobblemon 1.7, com acesso à todos os 1025 pokémon, Mega (até S/V), Dyna/Gigantamax, Z-Moves e Terastalização utilizando MegaShowdown e Complete Cobblemon Collection. O modpack é criado e atualizado para uso no servidor privado 'Cobblemon Lounge', porém pode ser utilizado no modo singleplayer ou LAN.

Todas as configurações e requerimentos do servidor já estão organizadas. Não é preciso alterar o modpack para entrar no servidor, apenas o atualize conforme necessário.

Esse modpack utiliza o Addon/Resource Pack "Complete Cobblemon Collection", que pode ser encontrado em 'https://modrinth.com/datapack/complete-cobblemon-collection-myths-and-legends-compat'.

---
Cobblemon Lounge Pack is the 'Cobblemon Lounge' server's modpack with Cobblemon 1.7, with access to all 1025 pokémon, Mega (up to S/V), Dyna/Gigantamax, Z-Moves and Terastalization trough MegaShowdown and Complete Cobblemon Collection. The modpack was created and is mantained for use in the private server 'Cobblemon Lounge', but it can be used in singleplayer or LAN.

All the configs and server requirements are already setup. There is no need to modify the modpack to join the server, only update it when needed.

This modpack uses the Addon/Resource Pack "Complete Cobblemon Collection", that can be found in 'https://modrinth.com/datapack/complete-cobblemon-collection-myths-and-legends-compat'.
